meta.name: anti-reversing-techniques
meta.description: Understand anti-reversing, obfuscation, and protection techniques encountered during software analysis. Use when analyzing protected binaries, bypassing anti-debugging for authorized analysis, or understanding software protection mechanisms.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解反逆向与混淆技术,辅助安全分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常分析受保护二进制,需要绕过反调试.
copy.tagline_en: Understand anti-reversing protection for authorized software analysis.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often analyze protected binaries and need to bypass anti-debugging.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会解释软件中的反调试、反虚拟机、代码混淆等保护技术,并针对具体样本给出分析或绕过思路。
howto.when: 当你要求分析受保护的二进制文件、为授权分析绕过反调试,或理解软件保护机制时。

say.text: 这个样本用了哪些反调试技术?
say.note: Claude会对照技能列出常见的检测点。

say.text: 帮我识别这段代码的混淆方式。
say.note: Claude会介绍控制流扁平化、字符串加密等手法。

say.text: 如何绕过这个程序的虚拟机保护?
say.note: Claude会给出VM分析与去虚拟化的思路。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude explains anti-reversing, anti-VM, obfuscation and other protection techniques in software, and suggests analysis or bypass approaches for specific samples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze protected binaries, bypass anti-debugging for authorized analysis, or understand software protection mechanisms.

say_en.text: What anti-debugging techniques does this sample use?
Help me identify the obfuscation in this code.
say_en.note: Claude explains flattening, string encryption, etc.

say_en.text: How do I bypass this program's VM-based protection?
say_en.note: Claude suggests VM analysis and devirtualization steps.
